calls.command: cat README.md digest/TEMPLATE.md; ls notes | wc -l

calls.content:
# Weekly digest: Friday 13 November 2026

Q01. Valdoria: GDP growth in the third quarter of 2026, quarter on quarter (percent, 2 decimal places)
Answer: 0.70
- notes/2026-11-05-valdoria-q3-gdp-second-estimate.txt: "Valdoria's third-quarter growth was revised up to 0.7% quarter on quarter in the second estimate."

Q02. Valdoria: retail sales volumes in September 2026, month on month: the latest estimate less the first (percentage points, 2 decimal places)
Answer: 0.30
- notes/2026-10-07-valdoria-september-retail-sales.txt: "Retail sales volumes fell 0.2% month on month in September, according to the first estimate from the statistics office."
- notes/2026-10-21-valdoria-retail-sales-second-estimate.txt: "Valdoria's September retail sales volumes were revised up to +0.1% month on month in the second estimate, as online sales were stronger than first reported."

Q03. Valdoria: the trade balance in September 2026: the latest estimate less the first (EUR billion, 1 decimal place)
Answer: 0.3
- notes/2026-10-15-valdoria-september-trade.txt: "Valdoria's trade balance swung to a deficit of EUR 1.8bn in September, according to the first estimate, after a surplus of EUR 0.6bn in August."
- notes/2026-11-12-valdoria-october-trade.txt: "September's trade deficit was revised to EUR 1.5bn in the second estimate."

Q04. Valdoria: the 10-year government bond yield at the end of October 2026 (percent, 2 decimal places)
Answer: 3.42
- notes/2026-11-02-valdoria-rates-month-end.txt: "The Valdorian 10-year government bond yield ended October at 3.42%, up from 3.18% at the end of September."

Q05. Kestria: GDP growth in the third quarter of 2026, quarter on quarter: the latest estimate less the first (percentage points, 2 decimal places)
Answer: 0.10
- notes/2026-10-14-kestria-q3-gdp-flash.txt: "Kestria's economy grew 0.9% quarter on quarter in the third quarter, according to the flash estimate, ahead of the 0.8% consensus."
- notes/2026-11-11-kestria-q3-gdp-third-estimate.txt: "Kestria's third-quarter growth was revised down to 1.0 per cent quarter on quarter in the third estimate, from 1.1 per cent in the second, as investment was marked lower."

Q06. Kestria: the central bank's policy rate after its November 2026 meeting (percent, 2 decimal places)
Answer: 3.25
- notes/2026-11-05-kestria-central-bank-holds.txt: "The Kestrian central bank kept its policy rate at 3.25% on Thursday, against a consensus that had expected a cut."

Q07. Norrland Industrial: revenue in the third quarter of 2026, change on the second quarter (percent, 2 decimal places)
Answer: 7.55
- notes/2026-10-08-capital-goods-sector-review.txt: "Norrland Industrial Valdoria 3,920 11.6% 16.5-17.0"
- notes/2026-10-22-norrland-industrial-q3-results.txt: "Norrland Industrial reported third-quarter revenue of EUR 4,216m, 5.9% higher than a year earlier, and an adjusted EBITA margin of 12.4%."

Q08. Norrland Industrial: adjusted EBITA margin in the third quarter of 2026, change on the second quarter (percentage points, 2 decimal places)
Answer: 0.80
- notes/2026-10-08-capital-goods-sector-review.txt: "Norrland Industrial Valdoria 3,920 11.6% 16.5-17.0"
- notes/2026-10-22-norrland-industrial-q3-results.txt: "Norrland Industrial reported third-quarter revenue of EUR 4,216m, 5.9% higher than a year earlier, and an adjusted EBITA margin of 12.4%."

Q09. Norrland Industrial: revenue guidance for 2026, the latest against the guidance before it (EUR billion, 1 decimal place)
Answer: raised, 0.3
- notes/2026-10-08-capital-goods-sector-review.txt: "Norrland Industrial Valdoria 3,920 11.6% 16.5-17.0"
- notes/2026-11-05-norrland-industrial-capital-markets-day.txt: "At its capital markets day, Norrland Industrial raised its revenue guidance for 2026 to EUR 16.9bn to EUR 17.2bn, on the strength of rail and grid orders taken since the summer."

Q10. Corvo Telecom: EBITDA margin in the third quarter of 2026, change on the third quarter of 2025 (percentage points, 2 decimal places)
Answer: 1.53
- notes/2026-10-13-corvo-telecom-q3-preview.txt: "A year ago, Corvo Telecom's third-quarter EBITDA margin was 37.1%."
- notes/2026-10-23-corvo-telecom-q3-results.txt: "Corvo Telecom, Valdoria's incumbent operator, reported third-quarter EBITDA of EUR 496m on revenue of EUR 1,284m, ahead of expectations."

Q11. Corvo Telecom: EBITDA margin guidance for 2026, the latest against the guidance before it (percentage points, 2 decimal places)
Answer: raised, 0.75
- notes/2026-10-13-corvo-telecom-q3-preview.txt: "For 2026, Corvo Telecom guides to an EBITDA margin of 37.5% to 38.5% and to capital expenditure of EUR 640m to EUR 680m."
- notes/2026-10-23-corvo-telecom-q3-results.txt: "The company raised its guidance for the 2026 EBITDA margin to 38.0% to 39.5%, and cut its capital expenditure guidance to EUR 620m to EUR 650m as network spending comes in below plan."

Q12. Bellamy Foods: revenue in the third quarter of 2026, change on the second quarter (percent, 2 decimal places)
Answer: 4.67
- notes/2026-10-06-consumer-staples-monthly.txt: "Bellamy Foods Valdoria 1,349 +3.1%"
- notes/2026-11-05-correction-bellamy-foods-q3-revenue.txt: "In our note of 4 November on Bellamy Foods' third-quarter trading update, the company's third-quarter revenue should have read EUR 1,412m, not EUR 1,421m."

Q13. Bellamy Foods: operating profit guidance for 2026, the latest against the guidance before it (EUR million, 1 decimal place)
Answer: lowered, -20.0
- notes/2026-10-20-bellamy-foods-q3-preview.txt: "Second-quarter revenue was EUR 1,349m, and the company guides to operating profit of EUR 410m to EUR 440m for 2026."
- notes/2026-11-04-bellamy-foods-q3-trading-update.txt: "It lowered its operating profit guidance for 2026 to EUR 385m to EUR 425m, citing cocoa costs and weaker sales in its snacks business."

Q14. Pellmark Retail: sales in the third quarter of 2026, change on the second quarter (percent, 2 decimal places)
Answer: 6.64
- notes/2026-10-28-pellmark-retail-restatement.txt: "Pellmark Retail restated its second-quarter sales to EUR 2,575m, from EUR 2,610m, to take out the Kestrian stores it sold on 30 June."
- notes/2026-11-11-pellmark-retail-q3-trading-update.txt: "Pellmark Retail's third-quarter sales were EUR 2,746m, 5.1% more than a year earlier; on a like-for-like basis, sales rose 3.4% year on year."

Q15. Pellmark Retail: like-for-like sales growth guidance for 2026, the latest against the guidance before it (percentage points, 2 decimal places)
Answer: unchanged, 0.00
- notes/2026-10-08-pellmark-retail-into-the-third-quarter.txt: "Second-quarter sales were EUR 2.61bn, and the company guides to like-for-like sales growth of 2% to 4% for 2026."
- notes/2026-11-11-pellmark-retail-q3-trading-update.txt: "The company reiterated its guidance for like-for-like sales growth of 2% to 4% in 2026."

Q16. Sorvik Energy: operating margin in the third quarter of 2026, change on the second quarter (percentage points, 2 decimal places)
Answer: -1.30
- notes/2026-10-09-sorvik-energy-q3-preview.txt: "In the second quarter, revenue was EUR 2,960m and the operating margin 15.2%."
- notes/2026-11-02-sorvik-energy-q3-results.txt: "Sorvik Energy's third-quarter revenue rose to EUR 3,113m, while its operating margin fell to 13.9% as maintenance at two fields cut volumes and lifted unit costs."

Q17. Kestria: consumer prices in October 2026, year on year (percent, 2 decimal places)
Answer: not in the notes

Q18. Sorvik Energy: capital expenditure guidance for 2026, the latest against the guidance before it (EUR million, 1 decimal place)
Answer: lowered, -200.0
- notes/2026-10-09-sorvik-energy-q3-preview.txt: "The company guides to capital expenditure of EUR 1.8bn to EUR 2.0bn for 2026."
- notes/2026-11-02-sorvik-energy-q3-results.txt: "The company cut its capital expenditure guidance for 2026 to EUR 1.5bn to EUR 1.9bn, deferring one project to next year."

Q19. Norrland Industrial: order intake in the third quarter of 2026 (EUR million, 1 decimal place)
Answer: 4600.0
- notes/2026-10-22-norrland-industrial-q3-results.txt: "Order intake was EUR 4.6bn, helped by two large rail contracts."

Q20. Pellmark Retail: like-for-like sales growth in the third quarter of 2026, year on year (percent, 2 decimal places)
Answer: 3.40
- notes/2026-11-11-pellmark-retail-q3-trading-update.txt: "Pellmark Retail's third-quarter sales were EUR 2,746m, 5.1% more than a year earlier; on a like-for-like basis, sales rose 3.4% year on year."

calls.summary: This week's digest is in digest/2026-11-13/: twenty answers with citations. Q17 is not in the notes: Kestria's October inflation is published on 16 November, and the notes have only our forecast and the consensus.
